chunks: As for those who adhere to the Book and are firm in devotion, We shall certainly not let the wages of those who are upright to go waste.

key_terms.الْمُصْلِحِينَ: the upright / those who do good

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who hold fast to the Quran and establish prayer?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are viewed as the perfect exemplars of holding fast to the Quran and establishing prayer with spiritual depth. It underscores the divine guarantee that the efforts of those who act as 'Mushlihun' (reformers or rectifiers) in society will never be lost, emphasizing the continuity of reward for consistent righteous action.
